'''2002 World Championship Top 8 Hayes Hunter DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Hayes Hunter]] at [[2002 World Championship]] (Top 8), finishing 5th; the list below is from the official Players Committee decklist form.<ref name="src">[http://www.theforce.net/ccg/sw/decks/hayesDS.pdf SWCCG Players Committee decklist form: Watto]</ref>

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Hayes Hunter]]
* '''Event:''' [[2002 World Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Top 8
* '''Finish:''' 5th
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Watto
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Source:''' [http://www.theforce.net/ccg/sw/decks/hayesDS.pdf PC decklist form]
